# telnyx_messaging_hosted_number_order_validation_codes (Action)

Submits the verification codes received by call or SMS on the numbers of a messaging hosted number order, proving that you control them.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `messaging_hosted_number_order_id` (String) The messaging hosted number order id.
- `verification_codes` (Attributes List) The code received on each phone number. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verification_codes))

<a id="nestedatt--verification_codes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `verification_codes`

Required:

- `code` (String) The verification code received on the number.
- `phone_number` (String) The +E.164 phone number the code was sent to.
